rows.label: Making & delivering what they sell
rows.filingLabel: Cost of revenue, exclusive of depreciation and amortization shown separately below

rows.label: Sales & marketing
rows.description: Sales and marketing expenses primarily consist of advertising and other ancillary expenses related to merchant, consumer, and Dasher acquisition, including certain consumer referral credits and Dasher referral fees paid to the referrers to the extent they represent fair value of acquiring a new consumer or a new Dasher, brand marketing expenses, personnel-related compensation expenses for sales and marketing employees, and commissions expense including amortization of deferred contract costs, as well as allocated overhead.

rows.label: Running the company (overhead)
rows.description: General and administrative expenses primarily consist of legal, tax, and regulatory expenses, which include litigation settlement expenses and sales and indirect taxes; personnel-related compensation expenses related to administrative employees, which include finance and accounting, human resources and legal; chargebacks associated with fraudulent credit card transactions; professional services fees; transaction-related costs; impairment expenses; bad debt expense; and allocated overhead.

rows.label: Research & development
rows.description: Research and development expenses primarily consist of personnel-related compensation expenses related to data analytics and the design of, product development of, and improvements to our platform, as well as expenses associated with the licensing of third-party software and allocated overhead.

rows.label: Wear and tear on equipment
rows.description: Depreciation and amortization expenses primarily consist of depreciation and amortization expenses associated with our property and equipment and intangible assets. Depreciation primarily includes expenses associated with equipment for merchants, computer equipment and software, office equipment, and leasehold improvements. Amortization includes expenses associated with our capitalized software and website development costs, as well as acquired intangible assets.

items.label: Deductions for stock paid to employees
items.note: When employee stock rises in value, the company deducts more than it booked as a cost

items.label: Research & development credit
items.note: A federal credit for spending on research

groups.label: Contracts
groups.note: The government buying products and services

groups.label: Grants
groups.note: Money for projects, such as research or factories

groups.label: Loans & loan guarantees
groups.note: Expected cost to taxpayers of loans the government made or backed
